operations.title: Benincasa closes the quadratic Kummer integral refinement
operations.body: Entries 1145-1146 are complete (events 863 and 864). Over O_K=Z[sqrt(2)], the source Kummer eigenline has integrality ideal (sqrt(2)); kappa=sqrt(2)k is primitive and O_K k/O_K kappa=F2 (Smith (1,2)). Its two-wall image is (1+sqrt(2),-sqrt(2),-1-sqrt(2),0); the first coordinate is a norm -1 unit, so the wall image is primitive and saturated, with exact top-residue cancellation. Thus the only integral defect is intrinsic to the source Kummer line. Physical activation remains undefined by Entries 1122-1123, so this center is now algebraically and integrally closed without a physical class or new carrier.

authority_basis.summary: Keep Nima synchronized with the quadratic Kummer integral closure.
